figures/affect-availability.svg: Replaced an overbroad adaptive/biased rule with an evidence check.
figures/belief-protection-loop.svg: Replaced a dense four-term intervention list with an understandable test and bounded the loop title.
figures/context-mechanisms.svg: Defined fluency and default without conflating each with possible consequences.
figures/decision-loop.svg: Separated observed feedback from the possibility of learning.
figures/economist-subscription-decoy.svg: Shortened the title while preserving the reported classroom counts and evidence boundary.
figures/heuristic-substitution.svg: Removed the categorical cue-validity rule and unnecessary heuristic catalogue.
figures/narrator-learning.svg: Corrected the unsupported claim that a decision record prevents retrospective bias.
figures/option-information-portrait.svg: Scoped the information-value advice to its instrumental decision purpose.
figures/overlapping-motive-systems.svg: Made the proposed status of the developmental hierarchy explicit in the title.
figures/perception-context-lab.svg: Made the geometric unit precise; both target circles have radius 34.
figures/wording-memory-study-redraw.svg: Used an outcome-based title instead of an identified memory-storage mechanism and added verified study denominators.
figures/priming-pathway.svg: Rebuilt four elements with converging inputs; removed the scientifically misleading accessibility-to-input arrow and the dense boundary-condition box.
figures/probability-judgment-map.svg: Reduced three competing lessons to one natural-frequency tree; retained all disease-example values and removed the unexplained Brier score. Branch labels and denominator are explicit.
figures/prototype-probability.svg: Separated intuitive resemblance from a probability update. Base rate and diagnostic evidence are independent inputs; removed the guarantee of calibration and the additive sample-size label.
figures/valuation.svg: Grouped eight spokes into four understandable influences and a readable path to choice, while explicitly retaining its teaching-synthesis status.
figures/judgment-and-decision-making-acc: Replaced eight sequential stages with four elements: expectations and signals converge on perception; action changes sampling and mismatch is feedback. Reliability is a weight, not an extra processing stage.
